name: PowerSynth four-input geometry loop-inductance surrogate

output.target: Reduced PEEC loop inductance at common 4 mm target mesh

baseDesign.name: TPEL 2019 linked official 2D_Case_2R reference - pin resolved

training.selection: Lowest validation MSE among widths 32/64 and seeds 42/43/44; test excluded until selection frozen

baseline.inputScaling: Same training-only input StandardScaler as the MLP
baseline.note: Simple validation-selected comparator; browser prediction uses the selected MLP.

source.attribution: PowerSynth contributors, E3DA and MSCAD laboratories, University of Arkansas. See source/THIRD_PARTY.md and source/LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt.
source.status: Paper-linked benchmark with declared physical-pin and wire adaptations; not a Figure 8 hardware replica.

generation.sampling: 16 corner and 8 face-center training points, domain center, source base, 134 train LHS points with seed42; independent 48-point validation/test LHS seeds43/44. Realized on the 0.001 mm lattice; full-geometry dedup before labels.
generation.testScope: Independent interior interpolation in the four-input rectangle. Corners and face centers are training-covered; test does not assess unseen boundaries or extrapolation.
generation.parameterization: y0=2+barHeight+gap; T1=(2,2,40,barHeight); T2=(2,y0,40-spineWidth,18-y0); T3=(42-spineWidth,y0,spineWidth,42-y0); D1=(8+dieOffset,y0+1,4,6); D2=(17+dieOffset,y0+1,4,6). Others fixed.

limitations: Educational surrogate for a specified numerical estimator; not hardware-validated.
Continuous interpolation inside a controlled four-input geometry family; other physical quantities remain fixed.
Input-dependent meshing can produce deterministic target roughness. Sentinel refinement does not bound every sample's error.
Uniform-current filaments, one thickness cell, DC resistivity; no automatic skin-depth mesh, capacitance, magnetic materials, thermal effects, or external fixture inductance.
